name: Hierarchical Vector Quantization
aliases: Hierarchical Vector Quantization for Volume Rendering
definition: A compression scheme using hierarchical vector quantization to encode static and time-varying multi-dimensional data, allowing direct rendering on programmable graphics hardware.
summary: Hierarchical Vector Quantization is a lossy compression algorithm for volumetric data that enables parallel GPU-based decompression and rendering, unlike wavelet methods requiring serial CPU processing.
